name: Expectancy
overview: Scripture reveals that expectancy is deeply rooted in trusting God's sovereign timing and purpose. Believers are called to wait upon God with confident hope, recognizing that our lives are limited and fleeting, yet God’s plans are for a hopeful and expected end. This expectancy is empowered by the Holy Spirit, enabling Christians to be faithful witnesses while anticipating God's provision and fulfillment of His promises. Even in human interactions, expectancy involves attentiveness and hope to receive from God or others according to His will.
